about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

39d1a70.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by GitHub Pages sha256-match origin/main at 39d1a70, twelve for twelve, before the shutter.

The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by GitHub Pages sha256-match this checkout, twelve for twelve, before the shutter - the deploy serves origin/main, and this branch changes no shipped byte.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the deployed page for #578 at build 2fc7e59, proved off the wire before the shutter: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs the page served were sha256-compared against this checkout and all twelve matched. its own page load (load A) - the five level-0 shots share it; shot LAST in that load. Route per shot as recorded for #536: DEV.freeze(true) at load, DEV.boot(), banner("", 0), S.t = 4, a re-freeze, DEV.tick(30), P.hp = 100, the pose below, grainSeed = 6, DEV.tick(1). Pose: DEV.cam(18.5, 5.5, floorAt(18.5, 5.5), 0.60, 0) then DEV.clear() then DEV.spawn("grunt", 1, 6); the load reads 1 hostile after the clear-and-spawn, and the camera pose reads back (18.5, 5.5) floor 1.00 ang 0.6000 pitch 0. This deal reads 8 hostiles / 23 props / 16 lights before the clear and layout 2159418787; the replaced row named 3105224175 (moved). Frame mean 51.45 (was 62.15, so -10.70), thirds 50.7 / 49.7 / 53.9, 0 of 763 rows under 24 and 0 under 34, every one of them printed by `node tools/recap.js check` off these bytes. What moved between this build and the build the replaced row bound (89e3e16) is js/20_level.js: #548 take two gives a dealt sector more than one room height, so a room stands taller and the dice that author its air re-cut every generated level. No threshold, no tolerance and no STRICT semantic was touched; the re-take is the fix.
